lines.t: One light, one truth The only fountain
Some were shown a glimpse while others walked in shade
Truth arrives in measure and not all see the same
What is clear to one may still be veiled to many more
So trust comes first and understanding opens doors
When the mind turns back, the light begins to fade
But the heart that keeps in space will never walk astray
Keep him in the front through every season, every hour
And peace will rise like morning from a hidden spring of power
Abide and the darkness breaks
Stay near and the waiting wakes
All things rest where his wisdom flows
in his will the river goes he is the only fountain the only knowledge that gives life
the more we seek his kingdom the more the truth shines bright first his reign first his ways
then revelation comes to stay in his understanding we are held and that is enough today
When the kingdom comes before the reach for self and pride
He pours out what was hidden and the soul is satisfied
Great sads like delight and the spirit learns to see
What was once a distant spark becomes a living mystery
Not by force, not by sight, but by the gift of holy
Seeing every answer grows in him, every season finds its meaning
And the one who stays near him in the quiet and the storm
Finds a deeper peace than knowledge ever could perform
Abide and the darkness breaks
Stay near and the waiting waits
All things rest where his wisdom flows
In his will the river goes
He is the only fountain
The only knowledge that gives life
The more we seek his kingdom
The more the truth shines bright
First his reign, first his ways
Then revelation comes to stay
In his understanding we are held
And that is enough today
See first the kingdom, let the rest unfold
More is given to the humble heart than silver, more than gold
Poured out by the Spirit, revelation fills the air
What was dim becomes a fire for the ones who wait in prayer
He is the only fountain, the only knowledge that gives life
The more we seek his kingdom, the more the truth shines bright
First is rain, first is waste
Then revelation comes to stay
In his understanding, we are hell
And that is enough today
The only fountain
The only knowledge
And in him, peace remains
We'll be right back.
